notes: Chunk 49: 1 program-list, 0 single-record, 24 not-a-list. The seven PolyU '/cc/.../dissertation/<name>' pages are Department of Chinese Culture faculty publication lists (the path word 'dissertation' is misleading), not graduates. The theses.lib.polyu.edu.hk pages in this batch are search forms, login walls and an error page; the database itself may still be a useful source via its Department browse, but no record pages were in this batch. The only program-list is the IIMA Vikram Sarabhai Library Koha search: the saved text is a capture of a different query than the URL given (an:28751 and holdingbranch:VSL, 3 marketing FPM theses with authors and years), so the integrator should treat it as evidence that the catalog exposes FPM theses by author/year rather than as a stable list page; the item type 'Thesis (FPM)' filter would be the general entry point. The three IIT Delhi '/alumni/phd' pages (CRDT, ITMMEC, Mechanical) are Drupal year-link indexes whose captured text holds no names and whose departments are outside operations; their pagesBelow entries were not in this batch. IEOR IIT Bombay has separate Ph.D. Alumni pages in its navigation that are not in this batch.
